New /admin/gfd-mob-spawns page + GfdMobSpawnsHandler, complementary to the item/mob-drops admin pages. Rows keyed by (zone_id, kind), same direct-file-access precedent applied to data/mob_spawns.json. 11 new tests, go test ./... clean. Commit 92cd662. Redeployed live IDUNA, verified real 401 on both new routes.
